LightningComponentBundle.description: Replaces the standard Global Search Results: shows ClickHelp knowledge articles plus matching Cases and Files.

property.name: pageSize
property.label: Results Per Page
property.description: How many results to show per page in each section before Next/Previous.

property.name: searchTerm
property.label: Fixed Search Term (optional)
property.description: Leave blank to read the term from the page URL.

property.name: showSearchBox
property.label: Show built-in search box
property.description: Enable to render an input box so this component can fully replace the header search.
